NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR LOGIN TO THE ZOOM MEETING
WITH THE FOLLOWING LINK: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89677108692 OR DIAL (669) 900-6833. MEETING ID: 896
7710 8692. THE QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS FEATURE WILL BE AVAILABLE DURING THE MEETING. THE
MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the City
Council beginning at 6 p.m. on January 28, 2021 via Zoom. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

CALL TO ORDER / FLAG SALUTE  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL  City Clerk

REPORTS

1.  CITY COUNCIL OPENING REMARKS
2.  ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PLAN – No action required.
3.  SENIOR NUTRITION PROGRAM – No action required.
4.  PUBLIC SAFETY UPDATE – No action required.
5.  QUESTIONS/ANSWERS – Staff will provide responses to questions submitted by 5:00 p.m. January 27, and to
  questions submitted through the Questions and Answers feature on a variety of issues that may be of importance
  to the speaker or the community at large. Topics that may be discussed include but are not limited to public
  safety, transportation, road conditions, City's budget, utility issues, development, City departments, animal
  control, housing, and parks.

I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall not less than 24-
hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City Council and to the following newspapers:
Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on the 25th day of January 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC, City Clerk
  Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it has been
  posted will also be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Department.

  Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the City Council.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
